title: A New Buffett Takes On the Task of Preserving Berkshire Hathaway's Culture
body: Berkshire Hathaway names Howard Buffett chairman as Warren Buffett steps down and remains on the board

questions.question: Is this the issuer's own cash, paper, or control — not a sector story?
questions.note: This is not the issuer’s own cash, paper, or control—it is a governance transition (board composition change) with cultural preservation as the focus, not a sector story.

pack_facts.text: Berkshire Hathaway looks to keep culture intact as Howard Buffett ...: Howard Buffett, 71, will assume a far different role as non-executive chairman, focused on preserving Berkshire's culture and values. It is the latest move in a years-long leadership transition.
Why Warren Buffett's Son Howie, Berkshire's New Chairman, Is Also Its ...: A new Buffett is taking on the task of preserving the storied conglomerate's culture.

Who is Howard Buffett, Berkshire Hathaway's new chairman?: Berkshire Hathaway said Howard Buffett would become the chairman of the $1.1 trillion conglomerate, succeeding legendary investor Warren Buffett, who would become chairman emeritus.
A new Buffett takes on the task of preserving Berkshire Hathaway ... - MSN: Howie Buffett's appointment as chairman ushers in a new era at Berkshire, and puts the conglomerate in uncharted territory.

Howard Buffett Is Berkshire Hathaway's New Chairman:What ... - Observer: Howard Buffett is Berkshire Hathaway's new chairman, but Greg Abel still runs the $1 trillion-plus company. Here is why Warren Buffett designed the roles that way.

Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire chairman, taps son Howard as ...: Berkshire Hathaway on Friday announced that legendary investor Warren Buffett has stepped down as executive chairman, tapping his son, Howard Buffett, as his replacement.
